tema.cambiar: Switch between light and dark theme
antesala.subtitulo: Pick a world, give it a character and watch it learn to live there.
mundos.pista: Each world tests something different. Missing ones can be installed right here.
mundos.error: Could not read the list of worlds.
mundos.elige_uno: Pick a ready world to continue.
mundo.minimo.desc: A small meadow with berries, mushrooms and a wolf. Ideal to watch it learn the basics.
mundo.archivos.desc: A biome of folders and files that sprout, rot and bite. It only touches its own biome.
mundo.crafter.desc: 2D survival with day and night: gather, craft tools, fight back and sleep. 22 achievements to unlock.
mundo.snake.desc: The classic snake, in real time in a browser. Needs an internet connection.
mundo.ajedrez.desc: Games against a four-level local opponent, or against Stockfish if you have it.
estado.ayuda.no_instalado: “Install” downloads its dependencies into IdA's environment.
estado.ayuda.falta_navegador: Needs Chromium for Playwright: “Install” downloads it.
estado.ayuda.sin_stockfish: Without Stockfish it plays its local opponent.
caracter.pista: Character shapes how IdA feels and decides. Pick one or tune it by hand.
caracter.personalizado_desc: Tuned by hand with the sliders.
caracter.azar_nota: Traits will come from the seed.
caracter.de_ficha_desc: The character of the individual you loaded.
rasgo.responsabilidad.desc: Prudence and respect for what it learned.
rasgo.extraversion.desc: Attraction to other creatures around it.
rasgo.umbral_miedo.desc: Minimum danger that triggers escape reflexes.
empezar.pista: With the recommended values, IdA lives as in the official measurement.
empezar.semilla_ayuda: The same seed gives the same life.
empezar.generaciones_ayuda: Successive lives: each one inherits from the previous.
empezar.sin_experiencia_ayuda: Turns off what it learns when deciding (for comparison).
empezar.tabula_rasa_ayuda: Deletes this world's saved lineage and memory before starting.
empezar.ficha_ayuda: A saved individual (JSON): its character and what it learned.
empezar.ficha_error: That file is not a valid individual record.
empezar.ficha_otro_mundo: That record belongs to {mundo}: learning does not carry over between worlds.
empezar.reemplazar: A life is already running. Stop it and start this one?
resumen.reproducible: Reproducible life: same seed, same life.
resumen.tiempo_real: Real-time world: the world sets the pace.
error.origen_no_permitido: Request rejected: it does not come from this page.
error.mundo_no_instalado: That world is not installed yet.
error.opcion_invalida: One of the world options is not valid.
error.campo_invalido: One of the values is not valid.
error.ficha_de_otro_mundo: The record belongs to another world.
error.ritmo_fijo: The pace cannot be changed in this world.
error.extra_desconocido: It is not known how to install that world.
error.red: No connection with the IdA server.
vivero.vacio_texto: Start a life from the lobby and it will show up here.
vivero.sin_escena: This world gives no scene: text view.
vivero.ritmo_fijo: In real time the world sets the pace.
vivero.terminada_error: The life stopped because of an error: {error}
vivero.diario_vacio: Nothing worth telling has happened yet.
vivero.snake_ventana: With the real website open in another window: this is what it feels and knows while it plays.
vivero.snake_sin_ventana: The browser runs in the background. «Also watch the real website» shows it in another window.
ritmo.ayuda.comodo: Comfy: easy to follow by eye
detalle.necesidades_ayuda: How short it is of each (0%: fine; 100%: depleted).
detalle.plus_decide: What it has learnt tipped the balance on this beat.
detalle.historia_ayuda: The events of this life, newest first (up to {n}).
sabe.nada: It knows nothing about this world yet.
sabe.leyenda: Dashed border: still a hypothesis; solid border: proven.
sabe.refutadas_vacio: {n} refuted in total; none among the most confident.
sabe.nota_nivel: Shown: the 20 most confident propositions and the requirements learnt in this life; the rest, in the Lab.
caracter.mutacion: Change from generation {g} in this same run.
caracter.sin_previa: The mutation between generations shows when the life moves on to the next generation; the whole lineage's, in T4b.
estirpe.pronto: The pedigree, ranking and records of its lineage are coming soon (phase T4b).
hecho.nace: {individuo} is born, generation {generacion}, with {heredados} inherited memories
hecho.sorpresa_mejor: Surprise: {accion} and it goes better than expected
hecho.sorpresa_peor: Surprise: {accion} and it goes worse than expected
hecho.sorpresa_modelo: Things with {el} don't go as predicted
lab.desde: You came from «{seccion}» in the Nursery: that view arrives with the Lab (T5).
lab.subtitulo: This is where you will see how IdA thinks inside.
lab.lista.latido: The animated heartbeat: the Wave going through its eight phases.
lab.lista.componentes: The Component map, with each biological analogue.
lab.lista.saber: What IdA knows and where it learned it.
lab.lista.quimica: Body, chemistry and mood over a lifetime.
lab.lista.comparar: Analysis and comparison of recorded lives.
lab.visor_texto: You can replay a recording (.jsonl.gz) with the scene viewer.
escena.pista: scene() check, not the Nursery. Load a .jsonl.gz or .jsonl recording, or a .json record.
escena.sin_escena: This record has no scene: text view.
escena.sin_gzip: This browser lacks DecompressionStream: decompress the recording and load the .jsonl.
